Hi Marissa,

Quick context: Atlas Health is consolidating purchases across three legal entities for Q1 usage. Our treasury team needs invoices segmented by payee (entity) but we also need a prioritized remittance path so our accounts payable can route payments to the correct legal entity in this order: Atlas Health Inc (primary), Atlas Health Services (secondary), Atlas Health EU (only if AP shortfall).

Can Redwood produce a fragmented invoice set (PDFs per entity) plus a machine-readable remit-priority table (CSV) that we can ingest into our ERP? Important constraints:
- Each invoice must carry the legal entity tax ID and the matching PO number.
- We need VAT treatment flagged per line where applicable.
- Preferred payment terms: net 30 with a single consolidated due date.

Would appreciate a proposed mapping and an ETA — we are aiming to pay by 3/10 if everything is in order.

Thanks,

Marissa / team — quick tech note from billing engine side. We can implement as separate invoice documents (recommended) with the following approach:

1) Invoice IDs: base invoice UUID + entity suffix (e.g., INV-9f3a2a-ATLINC, INV-9f3a2a-ATLSERV, INV-9f3a2a-ATLEU). That keeps traceability to the original charge set while providing distinct legal invoices.

2) VAT and line-level tax: our renderer supports per-line tax_rate and tax_code fields; we will echo tax_code from the PO bundle. If the PO bundle is missing VAT rates, we will attach a 'tax_uncertain' flag for manual review.

3) Remit-priority CSV: attached is a draft template (remit-priority-mapping.csv) with masked bank token column and priority ordering. Sample rows included.

4) Consolidated due date: technically possible via payment_terms on each invoice (set same due date). However, for settlement across entities, finance will need clearing instructions (internal GL transfer). Kimberly, can you confirm whether Redwood will be producing internal clearing instructions or Atlas will handle inter-entity settlement?

Attached: remit-priority-mapping.csv (draft) — CSV columns: payee_name,legal_entity_key,tax_id,bank_token_masked,priority_order,currency,note

-Karthik
